svg.title: Ask nimbls. Put NIMBL to work.
svg.desc: Illustrated planned network architecture: switches connect through NIMBL and bbcli to scheduled agents for monitoring, investigation and authorized changes. Local models and site history support ongoing work. Optional external model examples connect through a local disclosure gate and proposed relay.

g.text: NETWORK SITE MANAGEMENT / THE BIG PICTURE
Ask nimbls. Put NIMBL to work.
Agents keep watch, investigate issues, and handle routine network operations—powered by NIMBL.
Observe → investigate → act within scope → verify
Every run can inform the next.
No silent fallback to external models.
Planned architecture, not delivered functionality. Provider examples do not imply validated integrations or endorsement.
Solid arrows: operations and local context · Dashed arrows: guidance / optional assistance · OpenAI and Anthropic marks belong to their owners.
